name: Filamentive (Filamentive Limited)
summary: UK sustainability-focused filament brand in Bradford, built around post-industrial recycled feedstock from single-source waste streams. Range covers rPLA and rPETG in many variants plus TPU, ASA, PEEK and bio-derived Algae PLA, Hemp PLA and BioHT, offered in XL and refill spool formats. Certified to RoHS, REACH, ISO 14021 and EN-71, and an Ultimaker Material Alliance Partner.

product_lines.name: rPETG
product_lines.notes: Recycled PETG including Matte, Cosmic, Tough, Carbon Fibre and wood-infused variants

product_lines.name: Bio-derived
product_lines.notes: Algae PLA, Hemp PLA and BioHT; PLA-based, exact chemistry of BioHT not confirmed

additional_notes: Registered as Filamentive Ltd, company no. 09720892 (England & Wales), at Bradford Chamber Business Park, New Lane, Bradford, BD4 8BX. Claims over 100,000 kg of plastic diverted from landfill and runs a free PLA recycling scheme; a finalist for 'Material Company of the Year' several times between 2018 and 2021. A US-facing site runs at https://www.filamentive.com/usa/ off the back of a partnership with 3D Printlife. Social handles could not be confirmed via fetch, so endpoints.social is omitted entirely rather than guessed. No build plates or print surfaces found.

provenance.conflicts: It is unverified whether Filamentive extrudes in-house or contracts extrusion to a UK/EU toller - the company presents itself as a recycler/compounder and does not disclose its resin or extrusion suppliers. manufacturing_countries is therefore set to the United Kingdom on the strength of the company's own UK-manufacture positioning, and the exact facility is unconfirmed. Because no counterparty could be named, no suspected-manufactured-by relationship is recorded. Exact $/kg unconfirmed.
